description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to appoint Mr. K. G. A. K. Palugaswewa as an Assistant Secretary to the President with effect from 10.05.2018.
categorisation: This gazette content solely announces the appointment of a named individual (Mr. K. G. A. K.
